perks.name: A Nurse's Calling
perks.description: Within 28/30/32m of Survivors who are healing or being healed, you see their Auras.
perks.flavor: "Still attached to the fragments of her past life, she is drawn to those in need of help."

perks.name: A Place For Us
perks.description:
While healing another Survivor, you both gain Elusive.

Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, you both gain Elusive for 20/25/30s.

When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

perks.name: Ace in the Hole
perks.description:
Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it will have:
• A Visceral or lower rarity add-on.
• 50/75/100% chance for an Uncommon or lower rarity add-on.

When you escape, you keep your add-ons.
perks.flavor: "Everything that glitters isn't gold. But gold isn't worth a damn in this place, so this should come in handy." — Ace Visconti

perks.name: Adrenaline
perks.description:
When all Generators are completed, if you are downed or injured, heal instantly. Then, ignoring Exhausted:
• You gain 50% Haste for 4s.
• You gain Exhausted for 60/50/40s.

perks.name: Aftercare
perks.description:
You and up to 1/2/3 Survivors see each other's Auras whenever:
• You unhook them, or they unhook you.
• You finish healing them, or they finish healing you.

This effect lasts until you are hooked.

perks.name: Agitation
perks.description:
While carrying a Survivor:
• You gain 14/16/18% Haste.
• Your Terror Radius is 12m larger.
perks.flavor: "At some point, the excitement of hooking one of us becomes more important than the desire to kill us."

perks.name: Alert
perks.description:
Whenever the Killer breaks a Pallet or Breakable Wall, or damages a Generator:
• You hear a sound cue.
• You see their Aura for 3/4/5s.
perks.flavor: "I have true sight," — Feng Min

perks.name: Alien Instinct
perks.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, the farthest injured Survivor:
• Gains Oblivious for 40/50/60s.
• You see their Aura for 8s.
perks.flavor: "Yellow light's for my eyes only." — Dallas

perks.name: All-Shaking Thunder
perks.description: Whenever you fall from at least 1.25m, your lunge-attacks are 75% longer for 15/20/25s. Cooldown: 5s.
perks.flavor: "Go on. Run. Tell your friends I'm coming for them." — Portia Maye

perks.name: Any Means Necessary
perks.description:
While next to a Dropped Pallet, use ability button for 5/4/3s to reset it.

You see the Auras of Dropped Pallets.
perks.flavor: "I'll hit you with everything I've got. Then I'll do it again." — Yui Kimura

perks.name: Apocalyptic Ingenuity
perks.description:
After you rummage or unlock 1 Chest, while next to a Broken Pallet, use ability button for 3s to create a Fragile Pallet.

Within 24/28/32m, you see the Auras of Broken Pallets.

perks.name: Appraisal
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you earn 4 Tokens.

Spend 1 Token to rummage an empty Chest, up to 2 times per Chest.

You rummage Chests 40/60/80% faster.

perks.name: Autodidact
perks.description:
You start the trial with 0 Tokens, up to 3/4/5, and your good basic healing Skill Checks give 15% less progress.

While healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit:
• Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, you earn 1 token.
• Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, for each Token, you gain 15% more progress.
• You cannot get great basic Skill Checks.
perks.flavor: "There's no limit to what you can achieve, as long as you back with hard work." — Adam Francis

perks.name: Awakened Awareness
perks.description: While carrying a Survivor, within 16/18/20m of you, you see the Auras of other Survivors.

perks.name: Babysitter
perks.description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor:
• They gain 10% Haste for 20/25/30s.
• They leave no Pools of Blood for 20/25/30s.
• They leave no Scratch Marks for 20/25/30s.
• You see the Killer's Aura for 8s.
perks.flavor: "I promised to keep you shitheads safe, and that's exactly what I plan on doing." — Steve Harrington

perks.name: Background Player
perks.description:
Whenever the Killer picks-up another Survivor, for the next 10s, when you start running:
• Gain 50% Haste for 5s.
• Gain Exhausted for 30/25/20s.
perks.flavor: "You forget about me?" — Renato Lyra

perks.name: Bada Bada Boom
perks.description:
After repairing 20% of Generators, while next to a Window, use second ability button to trap it for 40/50/60s. All Survivors see that Window's Aura for that time.

When the Killer vaults that Window, the trap explodes and they gain 50% Hindered for 4s.

perks.name: Balanced Landing
perks.description:
Whenever you fall from at least 1.25m:
• You gain 50% Haste for 3s.
• You gain Exhausted for 60/50/40s.
• Your stagger is 75% shorter.
• Your Grunts from falling are 100% quieter.
perks.flavor: "I have jumped from higher places." — Nea Karlsson

perks.name: Bamboozle
perks.description:
Whenever you vault a Window, it is blocked for Survivors for 8/12/16s.

You basic-vault Windows 5/10/15% faster.

Only 1 Window can be blocked at a time.

perks.name: Barbecue & Chili
perks.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, for 5s, you see the Auras of all Survivors who are at least 60/50/40m away from the hooked Survivor.
perks.flavor: "I just can't take no pleasure in killing. There's just some things you gotta do. Don't mean you have to like it." — Drayton Sawyer

perks.name: Bardic Inspiration
perks.description:
While idle, use ability button to perform, empowering all Survivors within 16m for up to 15s. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. Roll a d20:
• 1 | You scream, but nothing happens.
• 2-10 | Basic Skill Checks give +1% progress.
• 11-19 | Basic Skill Checks give +2% progress.
• 20 | Basic Skill Checks give +3% progress.

If you complete the performance, this effect ends after 90s. Cooldown: 110/100/90s.
perks.flavor: "Listen closely! I'm about to save your life!" — Aestri

perks.name: Batteries Included
perks.description: Within 16m of a completed Generator, you gain 5% Haste. When you leave the range, this ends after 1/3/5s.
perks.flavor: "Surprise! Did you miss me, Andy?" — Chucky

perks.name: Beast of Prey
perks.description: Whenever you gain Bloodlust, gain Undetectable for 30/35/40s.
perks.flavor: "Where did she go?"

perks.name: Better Than New
perks.description:
Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, until they take damage:
• They bless and cleanse Totems 40/45/50% faster.
• They heal 40/45/50% faster.
• They unlock Chests 40/45/50% faster.

perks.name: Better Together
perks.description:
While you are repairing a Generator:
• Other Survivors see that Generator's Aura.
• Whenever the Killer downs a Survivor, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 20/25/30s.
perks.flavor: "Let's burn that lab to the ground." — Nancy Wheeler

perks.name: Bite the Bullet
perks.description:
While healing, you and the healed Survivor make no noises or Grunts of Pain. Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check:
• You lose only 3/2/1% progress.
• The Killer is not alerted.
perks.flavor: "I can do this." — Leon Scott Kennedy

perks.name: Bitter Murmur
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Auras of Survivors within 20m of it for 10s.

When all Generators are completed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 16/18/20s.

perks.name: Blast Mine
perks.description:
After repairing 40% of Generators, while next to a Generator, use second ability button to trap it for 100/110/120s. All Survivors see that Generator's Aura for that time.

When the Killer damages that Generator, the trap explodes, then:
• They are stunned for 4s.
• Everyone nearby looking at the detonation is blinded.
perks.flavor: "You want S.T.A.R.S.? I'll give you S.T.A.R.S.!" — Jill Valentine

perks.name: Blood Echo
perks.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, for 20/25/30s, all injured Survivors:
• Gain Exhausted.
• Gain Hemorrhage.
perks.flavor: "Attack an enemy with precision and their allies will feel it." — Renjiro's Doctrine 6:3

perks.name: Blood Pact
perks.description:
While you are not the Obsession:
• While you or the Obsession are injured, you see each other's Auras.
• Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, or they finish healing you, while within 16m of each other, you both gain 5/6/7% Haste.

While you are the Obsession, if you are hooked, another Survivor becomes the Obsession.

When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

perks.name: Blood Rush
perks.description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next 40/50/60s, while Exhausted, use ability button to lose Exhausted instantly.

This is disabled by conspicuous actions.
perks.flavor: "Just gotta... push through!" — Renato Lyra

perks.name: Blood Warden
perks.description:
When an Exit Gate is opened, once per trial, when you hook a Survivor, both Exits are blocked for 40/50/60s.

You see the Auras of Survivors within Exit Thresholds.
perks.flavor: "This is my world. And you can't ever leave." — Freddy Krueger

perks.name: Bloodhound
perks.description: Pools of Blood are brighter and last 2/3/4s longer.
perks.flavor: "Pebbles shimmering in the moonlight; my life drips down in a trail so easy to follow."

perks.name: Boil Over
perks.description:
You are a battler and do everything to escape a foe's grasp.
While being carried by the Killer, the following effects apply:
• Increases the strength of the Struggle Effects on the Killer from your Wiggling by 60/70/80%.
• Suppresses the ability of the Killer to read the Auras of all Hooks within 16 metres.
• Grants +33% of your current Wiggle progression upon landing, if the Killer drops from height.
"Buck and Wild,
Swing to be free,
Your hands just can't keep ahold of me." — Kate Denson's "Boil Over"

perks.name: Bond
perks.description: Within 20/28/36m, you see other Survivors' Auras.
perks.flavor: "We have to work as a team, I need you to survive so that I can survive!" — Dwight Fairfield

perks.name: Boon: Circle of Healing
perks.description:
While next to a Totem, use ability button to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Survivors within the Boon's range:
• While healing without a Med-Kit, they heal others 50/75/100% faster.
• While injured, other Survivors see their Aura.
perks.flavor: "Try this, it is better than anything you'll find in a pharmacy." — Mikaela Reid

perks.name: Boon: Dark Theory
perks.description:
While next to a Totem, use ability button to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Survivors within the Boon's range gain 3% Haste. When leaving the range, this ends after 2/3/4s.

perks.name: Boon: Exponential
perks.description:
While next to a Totem, use ability button to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Downed Survivors within the Boon's range:
• Recover 90/95/100% faster.
• Can fully recover.
perks.flavor: "It is not our time to die... probably." — Jonah Vasquez

perks.name: Boon: Illumination
perks.description:
While next to a Totem, use ability button to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Survivors within the Boon's range:
• See the Auras of Chests.
• See the Auras of Generators.

While you have a Boon Totem, you bless 150/175/200% faster.
perks.flavor: "A shift in reality. Heavy with hidden meanings." — Return

perks.name: Boon: Shadow Step
perks.description:
While next to a Totem, use ability button to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons. Survivors within the Boon's range:
• Leave no Scratch Marks.
• Their Auras cannot be seen by the Killer.

When leaving the range, this ends after 2/3/4s.
perks.flavor: "Stick to the shadows and cover your tracks." — Mikaela Reid

perks.name: Boon: Steadfast
perks.description:
While next to a Totem, use ability button to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Generators within the Boon's range:
• Regress 50% slower.
• Survivors repair them 8/9/10% faster.

Survivors within the Boon's range see the Auras of affected Generators.

perks.name: Borrowed Time
perks.description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor:
• They retain their unhook Endurance for 6/8/10s longer.
• They retain their unhook Haste for 10s longer.
perks.flavor: "Probably stings like hell, but it ain't gonna kill ya. Up and at 'em soldier. Time to move!" — Bill Overbeck

perks.name: Botany Knowledge
perks.description: You heal 30/40/50% faster.
perks.flavor: "Basic Botany Knowledge could save your life someday" — Claudette Morel

perks.name: Breakdown
perks.description:
Whenever you are unhooked:
• The Hook breaks, then is repaired after 180s.
• You see the Killer's Aura for 4/5/6s.

perks.name: Breakout
perks.description:
Within 5m of a carried Survivor:
• You gain 6/8/10% Haste.
• The carried Survivor wiggles 25% faster.
perks.flavor: "Come, we are going to rip our way out of this." — Yui Kimura

perks.name: Brutal Strength
perks.description: You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls, and damage Generators 10/15/20% faster.
perks.flavor: "It is more than muscles. A dark power motivates the beast."

perks.name: Buckle Up
perks.description:
While healing a downed Survivor, you both see the Killer's Aura.

Whenever you finish healing a downed Survivor or fully recover:
• The Survivor gains 50% Haste for 3/4/5s.
• The Survivor leaves no Scratch Marks for 3/4/5s.
perks.flavor: "Ghost beaters never leave a man behind." — Ash Williams

perks.name: Built to Last
perks.description:
While holding a depleted item, after hiding in a Locker for 14/12/10s, it is recharged to 99%.

Each time you recharge an item this way, it recharges 33% fewer Charges.
perks.flavor: "Architecture is the soul of civilisation." — Felix Richter

perks.name: Call of Brine
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it regresses 30/40/50% faster for 90s.

For that time, whenever a Survivor hits a good basic Skill Check while repairing that Generator, you are alerted.

perks.name: Calm Spirit
perks.description:
You do not scare Crows or scream.

You bless and cleanse Totems, and unlock Chests silently, and 8/9/10% faster.

perks.name: Camaraderie
perks.description: While you are struggling on Hook, when another Survivor gets within 16m, the timer is paused for 26/30/34s.
perks.flavor: "So, remember once you get in there... pretend like you don't care. There you go, you're learning my friend. You're learning." — Steve Harrington

perks.name: Celestial Witness
perks.description: Every 30s, if the Obsession is at least 40m away from you, you see their Aura for 2/2.5/3s. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.

perks.name: Champion of Light
perks.description:
While you are using a Flashlight, you gain 50% Haste.

Whenever you blind the Killer, they gain 20% Hindered for 6s. Cooldown: 60/50/40s.
perks.flavor: "I squeezed the Flashlight like my life depended on it, willing it to stop coming any closer." — Departure

perks.name: Change of Plan
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you earn 2 Tokens.

While hiding in a Locker and holding a non-event Toolbox, use second ability button and spend 1 Token to transform your Toolbox and add-ons into a Med-Kit of the same rarity with 80/90/100% Charges and random add-ons of the same rarity.

perks.name: Chemical Trap
perks.description:
After repairing 20% of Generators, while next to a Dropped Pallet, use second ability button to trap it for 40/50/60s. All Survivors see that Pallet's Aura for that time.

When the Killer breaks that Pallet, the trap explodes and they gain 50% Hindered for 4s.
perks.flavor: "How do we kill it, Ash?" — Ellen Ripley

perks.name: Clairvoyance
perks.description:
Whenever you bless or cleanse a Totem, while not holding an item, use UseItem to, for up to 10/11/12s and within 64m:
• See the Auras of Chests.
• See the Auras of Exit Gate Switches.
• See the Auras of Generators.
• See the Aura of the Hatch.
• See the Auras of Hooks.
perks.flavor: "Does anyone else see that? Just me?" — Mikaela Reid

perks.name: Clean Break
perks.description:
Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while being healed by another Survivor, use ability button to gain Broken.

After 75/60/45s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.
perks.flavor: "I'll be fine! Don't stick your neck out for me." — Taurie Cain

perks.name: Come and Get Me!
perks.description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor, while crouched and idle, use ability button to have injured and downed Survivors within 24m:
• Make no Grunts of Pain for 10/12.5/15s.
• Leave no Pools of Blood for 10/12.5/15s.
• Leave no Scratch Marks for 10/12.5/15s.

You scream, then the Killer sees your Aura for 5s.

perks.name: Conviction
perks.description:
After you finish healing 1 other Survivor, while downed with at least 25% recovery, use ability button to recover instantly.

You gain Broken, then, after 20/25/30s, you are downed instantly.

perks.name: Corrective Action
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you earn 1/2/3 Tokens, up to 5.

Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, earn 1 Token.

Whenever another Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, spend 1 Token:
• The missed Skill Check becomes a good Skill Check.
• You see that Survivor's Aura for 6s.
perks.flavor: "Cannot hurt to have another set of eyes on the problem." — Jonah Vasquez

perks.name: Corrupt Intervention
perks.description: When the trial starts, the 3 farthest Generators from you are blocked for 80/100/120s, or until you down a Survivor.
perks.flavor: "It shall be known across the land that the Gods curse the unfaithful." — (The Tablet of Adiris, 3.7)

perks.name: Coulrophobia
perks.description:
Survivors within your Terror Radius:
• Heal 20/25/30% slower.
• While healing, basic Skill Checks spin 50% faster.

perks.name: Counterforce
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you earn 1 Token.

Whenever you cleanse a Totem, earn 1 Token, then, you see the Aura of the farthest Totem for 10/12/14s.

For each Token, you cleanse Totems 25% faster.
perks.flavor: "I don't mind a little detective work." — Jill Valentine

perks.name: Coup de Grâce
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn 2 Tokens, up to 5.

Whenever you lunge-attack, spend 1 Token to make it 70/75/80% longer.

perks.name: Cross-Examination
perks.description: While in the Killer's Terror Radius and not being chased by the Killer, they leave Light Marks that last for 10s that you can see. While on the Killer's Light Marks, you gain Elusive. This ends after 3/4/5s.

perks.name: Cruel Limits
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed:
• You see the Auras of all Windows for 20/25/30s.
• All Windows are blocked for Survivors for 20/25/30s.
perks.flavor: "The specimen seems to be able to affect the state of nearby objects, as if they existed in some other form within a dimension alternate to our own." — Hawkins National Laboratory

perks.name: Cut Loose
perks.description:
While chased by the Killer, whenever you medium or fast-vault:
• For up to 4/5/6s, your medium and fast vaults are silent.
• During that time, whenever you medium or fast-vault, the timer is reset.

Cooldown: 45s.
perks.flavor: "I know how we can get out of here! Quick, this way!" — Thalita Lyra

perks.name: Dance With Me
perks.description: Whenever you fast-exit a Locker, medium-vault, or fast-vault, you leave no Scratch Marks for 5s. Cooldown: 25/20/15s.

perks.name: Dark Arrogance
perks.description:
You basic-vault Windows 15/20/25% faster.

Your missed basic-attack cooldown is 15/20/25% shorter.

Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, the duration is 25% longer.
perks.flavor: "Run all you want. I will not be denied." — Vecna

perks.name: Dark Devotion
perks.description:
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, for 35/40/45s:
• Your Terror Radius is set to 40m.
• The Obsession has your Terror Radius.
• You gain Undetectable.
perks.flavor: "And terror shall take hold of a defiant non-believer, who shall falsely announce my arrival." — (The Tablet of Adiris, 48.9)

perks.name: Dark Sense
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, when the Killer gets within 20m of you, for 13/14/15s:
• You see the Auras of Pallets and Windows within 32m.
• You see the Auras of other Survivors.
• You see the Killer's Aura.
perks.flavor: "Take it from an old-timer: Slow down, don't rush and try not to worry so much! The best way to beat him is to know how he thinks." — Murf, The Lost Tapes

perks.name: Darkness Revealed
perks.description: Whenever you search a Locker, you see the Auras of Survivors within 8m of Lockers for 6/7/8s. Cooldown: 30s.
perks.flavor: "Stay in the light, my children. In darkness, your fear will expose you." — Otto Stamper

perks.name: Dead Hard
perks.description:
Whenever you are unhooked, while injured and running, use ability button:
• You gain Endurance for 0.5s.
• You gain Exhausted for 60/50/40s.

perks.name: Dead Man’s Switch
perks.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, the next time any Survivor stops repairing a Generator for more than 2s, it is blocked for 30/35/40s. Cooldown: 30/35/40s.
perks.flavor: "I've seen the look on a man's face when he realises he's going to die." — Caleb Quinn

perks.name: Deadline
perks.description:
While injured, basic Skill Checks:
• Are 6/8/10% more likely to appear.
• Appear in random places.

Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose 50% less progress.
perks.flavor: "The night had been one desperate situation after another." — Departure

perks.name: Deadlock
perks.description: Whenever a Generator is completed, the Generator with the most progress is blocked for 15/20/25s.

perks.name: Deathbound
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor finishes healing another, the healer screams. Then, until the healer takes damage, while they are at least 12/8/4m away from the healed Survivor:
• The healer gains Oblivious.
• The healer sees the healed Survivor's Aura.

This can only apply to one Survivor at a time.

perks.name: Deception
perks.description:
Whenever you attempt to fast-enter a Locker:
• You do not enter the Locker.
• The Killer is alerted.
• You leave no Pools of Blood for 5s.
• You leave no Scratch Marks for 5s.

Cooldown: 25/20/15s.

perks.name: Decisive Strike
perks.description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next 40/50/60s: when the Killer picks you up, once per trial, hit a Special Skill check:
• Stun the Killer for 4s.
• Become the Obsession.

This is disabled by conspicuous actions. At the start of the trial, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
perks.flavor: "There is nothing to be scared of." — Laurie Strode

perks.name: Deerstalker
perks.description:
Every 40/35/30s, the Survivor with the least time in chase sees your Aura for 4s.

While a Survivor sees your Aura, you see their Aura.

perks.name: Deja Vu
perks.description: You see the Auras of the 3 Generators closest to each other and repair them 4/5/6% faster.

perks.name: Deliverance
perks.description: Once per trial, when you safely unhook another Survivor, you can unhook yourself. When you unhook yourself this way, you gain Broken for 160/140/120s.
perks.flavor: "I was raised by a strict man who taught me how to make the best of a bad situation." — Adam Francis

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description:
For each injured, downed, or hooked Survivor:
• You heal 16/18/20% faster.
• You unhook 16/18/20% faster.
perks.flavor: "When they come with a wrecking ball, build stronger walls." — Felix Richter

perks.name: Detective's Hunch
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, for 20s, within 32/48/64m of you:
• You see the Auras of Chests.
• You see the Auras of Generators.
• You see the Auras of Totems.
perks.flavor: "Are you able to tell us where you were last night?" — Detective David Tapp

perks.name: Discordance
perks.description:
Within 64/96/128m of you, whenever a Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you are alerted.

While that Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you see its Aura. When it is no longer being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, this ends after 4s.
perks.flavor: "Smartasses get killed. We always see to that." — The Legion

perks.name: Dissolution
perks.description: 3s after a Survivor takes damage from a basic-attack, for 13/14/15s, the next time a Survivor fast-vaults a Pallet while within your Terror Radius, it is destroyed.
perks.flavor: "The Garden shall be a place of perfect Joy; through Joy, nothing shall stand in our way." — Otto Stamper

perks.name: Distortion
perks.description:
When the trial starts, and after being chased for 15s, you earn 1 Token, up to 2.

While not downed, whenever the Killer attempts to see your Aura, spend 1 Token. Then, for the next 8/10/12s:
• The Killer cannot see your Aura.
• You leave no Scratch Marks.

perks.name: Distressing
perks.description:
Survivors within your Terror Radius repair 6/7/8% slower.

Your Terror Radius is 30% larger.

perks.name: Diversion
perks.description:
After hiding for 30/25/20s within the Killer's Terror Radius, while crouched and idle, use ability button to throw a pebble 20m away:
• The Killer is alerted.
• The pebble leaves Scratch Marks.
perks.flavor: "There's what is easy and then there's what is right. If you confuse the two, there's no telling what you become." — Adam Francis

perks.name: Do No Harm
perks.description:
While healing another Survivor, for each Hook State they have:
• You heal 30/35/40% faster.
• Great basic Skill Checks, grant 3% more progress.
• Basic Skill Checks are 5% more likely to appear.

perks.name: Dominance
perks.description:
The first time each Totem is being blessed or cleansed by a Survivor:
• It is blocked for 25s.
• They scream.
• You see their Aura for 3/4/5s.
perks.flavor: "Tragic, is it not? How powerless you must feel." — Dracula

perks.name: Dragon’s Grip
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, for the next 30s, the first Survivor that repairs that Generator:
• They scream, then you are alerted to their position for 4s.
• They gain Exposed for 60s.

Cooldown: 60/45/30s.
perks.flavor: "Such potential in this compound... even the slightest trace causes unnatural effects." — Journal of Talbot Grimes

perks.name: Dramaturgy
perks.description:
While healthy and running, use ability button:
• You gain 25% Haste for 2s.
• You gain Exhausted for 60/50/40s.

Then, one happens at random:
• You gain 25% Haste for 2s.
• You gain Exposed for 12s.
• You gain a random rare item with random add-ons.
• You scream, but nothing happens.

The same effect cannot happen twice in a row.
perks.flavor: "Take the part. It's a good movie, he says. What's the worst that can happen?" — Nicolas Cage

perks.name: Duty of Care
perks.description: While healthy, whenever you take a protection hit, other Survivors within 12m gain 25% Haste for 4/5/6s.

perks.name: Dying Light
perks.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession, earn 1 token.

While the Obsession is alive, for each Token:
• Other Survivors heal 2/2.5/3% slower.
• Other Survivors repair 2/2.5/3% slower.
• Other Survivors sabotage Hooks 2/2.5/3% slower.

The Obsession:
• Heals other Survivors 33% faster.
• Unhooks other Survivors 33% faster.
perks.flavor: "This isn't a man..." — Dr Sam Loomis

perks.name: Empathic Connection
perks.description:
You heal other Survivors 30/35/40% faster.

Injured Survivors see your Aura.

perks.name: Empathy
perks.description: Within 64/96/128m, you see the Auras of injured Survivors.

perks.name: Enduring
perks.description: While not carrying a Survivor, Pallet-stuns are 40/45/50% shorter.
perks.flavor: "He stops at nothing."

perks.name: Eruption
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, when you down a Survivor, all Generators damaged this way:
• Explode, lose 10% progress and start regressing.
• Survivors repairing them scream, then you see their Auras for 8/10/12s.

Cooldown: 30s.
perks.flavor: "It can use weapons?" — Jill Valentine

perks.name: Extrasensory Perception
perks.description:
After crouching for 4s:
• You see Auras in an expanding radius up to 44m.
• You gain Elusive.
• You gain Oblivious.

When you stop crouching, or after 11s, cooldown: 60/50/40s.

perks.name: Exultation
perks.description:
Whenever you Pallet-stun the Killer:
• Your item rarity is upgraded to the next tier, if possible.
• If the item was upgraded, it recharges 75% Charges.

Cooldown: 30/25/20s.
perks.flavor: "You will not take me this day!" — Trevor

perks.name: Eyes of Belmont
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Killer's Aura for 1/2/3s.

Whenever you see the Killer's Aura for a duration, it is 2s longer.
perks.flavor: "Ha! Your secret has been revealed!" — Trevor

perks.name: Fast Track
perks.description:
Whenever you unhook another Survivor, you earn 1 Token, up to 1/2/3.

While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains 5% permanent progress.
perks.flavor: "The weak are sacrificed first. It's nature, it's business... it's the truth most refuse to face." — Yun-Jin Lee

perks.name: Finesse
perks.description:
While healthy, you fast-vault 20% faster.

Whenever you fast-vault, cooldown: 40/35/30s.
perks.flavor: "Just need to push myself a bit further." — Lara Croft

perks.name: Fire Up
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, earn 1 Token, up to 5.

For each Token:
• You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls 6/7/8% faster.
• You damage Generators 6/7/8% faster.
• You pick-up and drop Survivors 6/7/8% faster.
• You basic-vault Windows 6/7/8% faster.
perks.flavor: "Now why don't you just fucking die?" — Freddy Krueger

perks.name: Five Moves Ahead
perks.description:
While you are in the Killer's Terror Radius or chased by the Killer:
• You see the Auras of the 5 closest Pallets.
• After you drop a Pallet, you start moving 50% earlier.
• Whenever you drop a Pallet, cooldown: 40/35/30s.

perks.name: Fixated
perks.description:
While walking, you gain 10/15/20% Haste.

You see your own Scratch Marks.
perks.flavor: "I wanna finish what we started. I want to kill it." — Nancy Wheeler

perks.name: Flashbang
perks.description:
After repairing 50/45/40% of Generators, while hiding in a Locker, use ability button to craft a Flashbang.

When you use the Flashbang:
• Everyone nearby looking at the detonation is blinded.
• The Killer is alerted.
perks.flavor: "Get outta my face!" — Leon Scott Kennedy

perks.name: Flip-Flop
perks.description: While downed, whenever the Killer picks you up, 50% of your recovery progress is added to your wiggle progress, up to 40/45/50%.
perks.flavor: "Catch ya on the flip-flop." — Ash Williams

perks.name: Flow State
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, earn 1 Token, up to 5.

For each Token:
• You bless and cleanse Totems 13/14/15% faster.
• You heal 13/14/15% faster.
• You unhook Survivors 13/14/15% faster.

perks.name: Fogwise
perks.description: While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you see the Killer's Aura for 4/5/6s.
perks.flavor: "I have seen great cruelty... and I have also seen another way." — Vittorio Toscano

perks.name: For the People
perks.description:
While healthy and healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit, use ability button to heal them instantly:
• You take damage.
• You gain Broken for 80/70/60s.
• You become the Obsession.

When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.
perks.flavor: "We can write our own story and decide how it really ends." — Zarina Kassir

perks.name: Forced Hesitation
perks.description: Whenever you down a Survivor, other Survivors within 16m of the downed Survivor gain 20% Hindered for 10s. Cooldown: 40/35/30s.
perks.flavor: "THE ORGANIC MIND'S CAPACITY FOR EMPATHY GOES BEYOND HINDRANCE!" — HUX-A7-13

perks.name: Forced Penance
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor takes a protection hit, they gain Broken for 60/70/80s.

perks.name: Forever Entwined
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor takes damage, you earn 1 Token, up to 6/7/8.

For each Token:
• You hook Survivors 4% faster.
• You pick-up and drop Survivors 4% faster.

perks.name: Franklin's Demise
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, they drop their item.

Within 32/48/64m, you see the Auras of dropped items.
perks.flavor: "Sally, I hear something. Stop! Stop!" — Franklin Hardesty

perks.name: Friendly Competition
perks.description: Whenever you finish repairing a Generator with at least 1 other Survivor, Survivors who finished repairing it repair 10% faster for 80/85/90s.
perks.flavor: "C'mon, let's do this!" — Thalita Lyra

perks.name: Friends ‘Til the End
perks.description:
Whenever you Hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession:
• The Obsession gains Exposed for 20s.
• You see the Obsession's Aura for 6/8/10s.

Whenever you Hook the Obsession, another Survivor:
• Screams, then you are alerted.
• Becomes the Obsession.
perks.flavor: "I got some fresh meat lined up, and I'm not gonna let you spoil it, not this time!" — Chucky

perks.name: Fruits of Your Labor
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn 1 Token.

Whenever you finish repairing a Generator, for each Token:
• You gain 5% Haste for 2s.
• You gain 10/15/20% healing progress.

perks.name: Furtive Chase
perks.description:
Whenever you hook the Obsession:
• You gain 10% Haste for 14/16/18s.
• You gain Undetectable for 14/16/18s.

Whenever the Obsession is unhooked, the Survivor who unhooked them becomes the Obsession.
perks.flavor: "You have no idea what I have planned for you. It'll be in the news for weeks. I'll make sure of that." — The Ghost Face

perks.name: Game Afoot
perks.description:
While chasing the Obsession, whenever you basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, or damage Generators, you gain 10% Haste for 8/9/10s.

Whenever you damage the Survivor with the most chase time with a basic-attack, they become the Obsession.
perks.flavor: "This one might actually be a challenge..." — Sonhadores Sombrios, Issue #3

perks.name: Gearhead
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor takes damage, for the next 30s, whenever a Survivor repairing a Generator hits a good basic Skill Check, you see their Aura for 6/7/8s.
perks.flavor: "Sometimes a man's best work is what puts him in the grave." — The Prison Warden

perks.name: Genetic Limits
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor takes damage, they gain Exhausted for 6/7/8s.
perks.flavor: "THE ORGANIC BODY IS SO LIMITED!" — HUX-A7-13

perks.name: Ghost Notes
perks.description:
While you have Exhausted, your Scratch Marks disappear 50% faster.

You lose Exhausted 5/7.5/10% faster.

perks.name: Grim Embrace
perks.description:
Whenever you Hook a Survivor for the first time, earn 1 Token.

When you move 16m away from the hooked Survivor, all Generators are blocked for 6/8/10s.

When you have 4 Tokens, when you move 16m away from the hooked Survivor:
• All Generators are blocked for 40s.
• You see the Obsession's Aura for 10s.
perks.flavor: "Are we nothing but prisoners to our sorrow?" — Carmina Mora

perks.name: Hardened
perks.description: When you have blessed or cleansed a Totem and unlocked a Chest, whenever you would scream, you see the Killer's Aura for 3/4/5s instead.
perks.flavor: "Got to keep quiet. That thing is still out there." — Lara Croft

perks.name: Haywire
perks.description:
Exit Gate Switches with at least 80% progress regress at 80/90/100% speed.

While they are regressing, Survivors see the Exit Gate Lights flicker randomly.

perks.name: Head On
perks.description: After hiding in a Locker for 3s, fast-exit to stun the Killer for 3s if they are within 2.5m, then gain Exhausted for 60/50/40s.
perks.flavor: "People are remembered for the challenges they overcome. You can run away and forget what you're capable of or you can face your fears and remind the world of who you are." — Jane Romero

perks.name: Help Wanted
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.

When any compromised Generator is completed by Survivors:
• Your successful basic-attack cooldowns are 25% shorter for 70/80/90s.
• Generators not being repaired regress at 150% speed for 70/80/90s.
• Other Generators lose compromised.

Up to 3 Generators can be compromised at a time.

perks.name: Hex: Blood Favor
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured by your basic-attack, Upright Pallets within 32m of them are blocked for 13/14/15s.
perks.flavor: "It would be no leap of the imagination to suggest that the Trials are a biological response of sorts." — Journal of Talbot Grimes

perks.name: Hex: Crowd Control
perks.description:
The first time a Survivor medium or fast-vaults a Window, a Dull Totem ignites.

The last 4/5/6 Windows Survivors medium or fast-vault are blocked.

You basic-vault blocked Windows 15% faster.

You see the Auras of blocked Windows within 24m.
perks.flavor: "You have no control. People like you never did." — Ji-Woon Hak

perks.name: Hex: Devour Hope
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked while you are at least 24m away, earn 1 Token, up to 5:
• 2 Tokens | 10s after hooking a Survivor, gain 3/4/5% Haste for 10s.
• 3 Tokens | Survivors gain Exposed.
• 5 Tokens | You can Kill downed Survivors.
perks.flavor: "If you do nothing, you have their blood on your hands. If you save them, her hunger grows."

perks.name: Hex: Face the Darkness
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.

Every 35/30/25s, other Survivors not within your Terror Radius scream, then you see their Auras for 2s.

When the hexed Survivor is downed or becomes healthy, the Hex Totem is extinguished.
perks.flavor: "I shall make an example of one. These mewling worms will never know peace." — Tarhos Kovács

perks.name: Hex: Haunted Ground
perks.description:
When the trial starts, 2 Dull Totems ignite.

When either of those Hex Totems is blessed or cleansed:
• All Survivors gain Exposed for 40/50/60s.
• The other Totem is extinguished.
perks.flavor: "Her home become profane."

perks.name: Hex: Hive Mind
perks.description:
The first time you hook a Survivor, a Dull Totem ignites.

The Auras of Generators show their progress.

When 1 Generator remains:
• All Generators explode, lose 6/8/10% progress and start regressing.
• The Hex Totem is extinguished.

perks.name: Hex: Huntress Lullaby
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you hook a Survivor, earn 1 Token. For each Token, Basic Skill Check warnings appear later and good success zones are smaller.

While you have 5 Tokens, Basic Skill Check warnings don't appear.

Whenever a Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, they lose 2/4/6% more progress.
perks.flavor: "That song, it drives me crazy!"

perks.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
perks.description:
When all Generators are completed, a Dull Totem ignites:
• Survivors gain Exposed.
• You gain 2/3/4% Haste.

Within 4m, Survivors see the Hex Totem's Aura, expanding to 24m over 30s.
perks.flavor: "And the beast became faster and more powerful as if The Entity's shadowy whips were lashing at its back."

perks.name: Hex: Nothing But Misery
perks.description:
After you damage Survivors with a basic-attack 4 times, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack:
• They gain 5% Hindered for 10/12.5/15s.
• They vault 10% slower for 10/12.5/15s.

perks.name: Hex: Overture of Doom
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites and hexes the farthest Generator from it.

After a Survivor repairs the hexed Generator for 5 seconds:
• You gain Undetectable for 20/25/30s.
• For that time, your Terror Radius is set to that Generator.

When the hexed Generator is repaired, the next farthest Generator is hexed.

perks.name: Hex: Pentimento
perks.description:
You see the Auras of cleansed Totems, and can rekindle each once.

Within 16m, Survivors see the Auras of Rekindled Totems.

While a Totem is rekindled, Survivors heal and repair 20% slower, plus 1/2/3% for each additional Rekindled Totem.

When all 5 Totems are rekindled at once, they are blocked.
perks.flavor: "Though a pentimento is an inherently concealed piece of art, there is something to be said of the desire to discover that which is beyond." — A Guide to Art & Process (1961)

perks.name: Hex: Plaything
perks.description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.

For 90s, the Hex Totem is blocked to other Survivors.

The hexed Survivors:

• Gain Oblivious.
• Within 24/20/16m of the Hex Totem, they see its Aura.

perks.name: Hex: Retribution
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a Survivor starts blessing or cleansing a Totem, they gain Oblivious for 40/50/60s.

Whenever a Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 20s.
perks.flavor: "Bloody fool, you pulled the trigger on yourself." — Caleb Quinn

perks.name: Hex: Ruin
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

While a Generator is not being repaired, it regresses at 100/125/150% speed.
perks.flavor: "A curse is upon you. It will cause your ruin."

perks.name: Hex: Scared to Death
perks.description:
After you hook 3 different Survivors, a Dull Totem ignites.

While chasing a Survivor, whenever you basic-break a Pallet, Survivors within 13m:
• Scream.
• Gain 11/12/13% Hindered for 3s.

perks.name: Hex: The Third Seal
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic or special-attack, they gain Blindness.

This applies for up to 2/3/4 Survivors.
perks.flavor: "She touched your skin, you bear the witch's mark!"

perks.name: Hex: Thrill of the Hunt
perks.description:
The first time you hook a Survivor, a Dull Totem ignites.

When you hook a Survivor, block all Hex Totems for 4/5/6s for each lit Hex Totem.

perks.name: Hex: Two Can Play
perks.description:
While this Hex is dull, each time you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor 4/3/2 times, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor you are not carrying, they are blinded for 1.5s.
perks.flavor: "From now on, no more Mr Good Guy." — Chucky

perks.name: Hex: Under Your Thumb
perks.description:
The first time a Survivor gains a Hook State, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a running Survivor gains Haste within 32m of you, you are alerted.

Running Survivors cannot gain more than 25/20/15% Haste at a time.

perks.name: Hex: Undying
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

When another Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, it replaces this one and keeps any Tokens it had.

You see the Auras of Survivors within 2/3/4m of Dull Totems.

perks.name: Hex: Wretched Fate
perks.description:
The first time a Generator is completed, a Dull Totem ignites.

The Obsession:
• Repairs 27/30/33% slower.
• Sees the Hex Totem's Aura within 12m.
perks.flavor: "So toil, mortal, toil! Your effort will be for naught!" — Dracula

perks.name: Hoarder
perks.description:
When the trial starts, 2 more Chests appear.

Whenever a Survivor picks-up an Item or starts unlocking a Chest within 32/48/64m of you, you are alerted.

perks.name: Hope
perks.description: When all Generators are completed, you gain 3/4/5% Haste.
perks.flavor: "Buckle up, fuckos! Let's roll." — Nikki, The Lost Tapes

perks.name: Hubris
perks.description: Whenever you are stunned by a Survivor, they gain Exposed for 20/25/30s. Cooldown: 20s.
perks.flavor: "You have made a grave mistake, standing in opposition to me this day." — Tarhos Kovács

perks.name: Human Greed
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor gets within 8m of a locked Chest, you see their Aura for 3/4/5s.

You can lock unlocked Chests. Cooldown: 10s.

You see the Auras of locked Chests.
perks.flavor: "Come running, one and all, and see what fortune awaits you." — Dracula

perks.name: Hyperfocus
perks.description:
Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn 1 Token, up to 6.

For each Token, basic Skill Checks:
• Appear 4% more often.
• Spin 4% faster.
• Whenever you hit a great, give 10/20/30% more progress.

Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, hit a good Skill Check, or stop healing or repairing, lose all Tokens.

perks.name: Hysteria
perks.description: Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, all injured Survivors gain Oblivious for 30/35/40s. Cooldown: 20s.
perks.flavor: "Sorry I got a little jumpy there. Didn't know quite what to expect." — Robert Kendo

perks.name: I'm All Ears
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor fast-enters or fast-exits a Locker, or medium or fast-vaults within 48m of you, you see their Aura for 8s. Cooldown: 60/45/30s.
perks.flavor: "There is no need to worry. I've been preparing my whole life for this." — The Ghost Face

perks.name: Infectious Fright
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor is downed, Survivors within your Terror Radius scream and you are alerted for 4/5/6s.
perks.flavor: "Horror overcomes the heart of infidels who cry at the feet of the fallen." — (Hymn of Praise, 11.4)

perks.name: Inner Focus
perks.description:
Whenever the Killer damages another Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura for 6/8/10s.

You see other Survivors' Scratch Marks.
perks.flavor: "The death, the trauma, the fear... it all leads here. The Overlap." — Haddie Kaur, Ravages of the Abyss Episode 11

perks.name: Inner Strength
perks.description: Whenever you cleanse a Totem, while injured and not Broken, after hiding in a Locker for 10/9/8s, you become healthy instantly.
perks.flavor: "All this time I've been trying so hard to pretend like everything's fine, but it's not." — Nancy Wheeler

perks.name: Insidious
perks.description: After being idle for 2s, gain Undetectable. Whenever you act, this ends after 6/7/8s.

perks.name: Invocation: Treacherous Crows
perks.description:
While in the Basement next to the circle, use second ability button to invoke. While invoking, other Survivors see your Aura and can join your Invocation.

When the Invocation is completed:
• Whenever the Killer scares a Crow while a Survivor is in their Terror Radius, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for 1/1.5/2s.
• You become injured.
• You gain Broken.

Each Invocation can only be completed once per trial.
perks.flavor: "Remember your training. They taught you all about the crows." — Taurie Cain

perks.name: Invocation: Weaving Spiders
perks.description:
While in the Basement next to the circle, use ability button to invoke. While invoking, other Survivors see your Aura and can join your Invocation.

When the Invocation is completed:
• All Generators gain 8/9/10 permanent charges.
• You become injured.
• You gain Broken.

Each Invocation can only be completed once per trial.
perks.flavor: "I call upon the spirits of the night, to aid us in our desperate flight!" — Sable

perks.name: Iron Grasp
perks.description:
While carrying a Survivor:
• They wiggle 10/11/12% slower.
• Their wiggle is 75% weaker.

perks.name: Iron Maiden
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor exits a Locker:
• They gain Exposed for 30s.
• They scream, then you are alerted to their location for 4s.

You open Lockers 30/40/50% faster.
perks.flavor: "This is no place for cowards." — The Legion

perks.name: Iron Will
perks.description: While injured and not Exhausted, your Grunts of Pain are 80/90/100% quieter.

perks.name: Kindred
perks.description:
While you are hooked, all Survivors see each others' Auras. While the Killer is within 14/15/16m, all Survivors sees the Killer's Aura.

While another Survivor is hooked, you see the Auras of other Survivors. While the Killer is within 14/15/16m of the hooked Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura.
perks.flavor: "Be kind to one another, We're all in this together" — Sujan, The Lost Tapes

perks.name: Knock Out
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, for the next 6s, if they move 10m away from it, they gain 20% Hindered for 2/3/4s.

This ends early if the Pallet is broken.
perks.flavor: "Oh, that gun's no good. The old way... with a sledge! You see, that way's better. They die better that way." — Nubbins Sawyer

perks.name: Languid Touch
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor within 36m of you scares a Crow, they gain Exhausted for 6/8/10s. Cooldown: 5s.
perks.flavor: "Submit to me. It is inevitable." — Vecna

perks.name: Last Stand
perks.description: After hiding for 120/105/90s within the Killer's Terror Radius, when you fast-vault, once per trial, stun the Killer for 3s if they are within 2.5m.

perks.name: Lay Waste
perks.description: Whenever you damage a Generator, for each Charge it has, it regresses 2% faster. Cooldown: 55/50/45s.

perks.name: Leader
perks.description:
Within 10m of you, other Survivors:
• Cleanse Totems 20/25/30% faster.
• Heal 20/25/30% faster.
• Open Exit Gates 20/25/30% faster.
• Sabotage Hooks 20/25/30% faster.
• Unhook Survivors 20/25/30% faster.
• Unlock Chests 20/25/30% faster.

After they leave your range, this ends after 20s.

perks.name: Left Behind
perks.description: When all other Survivors are dead, while within 24/28/32m of the Hatch, you see its Aura.
perks.flavor: "I'm not horse-shittin' around. I'm doing this alone!" — Bill Overbeck

perks.name: Lend a Hand
perks.description: Whenever you bless or cleanse 1 Totem, while healing another Survivor and only once per Survivor, use second ability button to give them 2/3/4 permanent healing charges.

perks.name: Lethal Pursuer
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 7/8/9s.

Whenever you see a Survivor's Aura for a duration, it is 2s longer.
perks.flavor: "...it knows what it wants and won't stop till it gets it." — Carlos Oliveira

perks.name: Leverage
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor unhooks another or themselves, they heal 20/25/30% slower for 60s.
perks.flavor: "Good. Now we can move in for the kill." — Adriana Imai

perks.name: Light-footed
perks.description:
While healthy and running, your footsteps are silent to the Killer.

Whenever you do a fast-action, cooldown: 14/12/10s.
perks.flavor: "Come on, cat." — Ellen Ripley

perks.name: Lightborn
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor attempts to blind you, you see their Aura for 6/8/10s.

You cannot be blinded.
perks.flavor: "These monsters... they adapt! They emerge with strange new abilities." — Vigo, Vigo's Journal

perks.name: Lightweight
perks.description: Your Scratch Marks disappear 3/4/5s faster and appear more spread out.

perks.name: Lithe
perks.description:
Whenever you medium or fast-vault:
• You gain 50% Haste for 3s.
• You gain Exhausted for 60/50/40s.
perks.flavor: "U mad?" — Feng Min

perks.name: Low Profile
perks.description:
When all other Survivors are downed or hooked, for 70/80/90s:
• You make no Grunts of Pain.
• You leave no Pools of Blood.
• You leave no Scratch Marks.

perks.name: Lucky Break
perks.description:
While injured, for up to 40/50/60s:
• You leave no Pools of Blood.
• You leave no Scratch Marks.

For each second spent healing another Survivor, recharge the duration by 1s.

perks.name: Lucky Star
perks.description:
While hiding in a Locker, you make no Grunts of Pain.

Whenever you exit a Locker, for 30s:
• You see the Aura of the closest Generator.
• You see the Auras of other Survivors.
• You make no Grunts of Pain.
• You leave no Pools of Blood.

Cooldown: 35/30/25s.
perks.flavor: "You are my... lucky star..." — Ellen Ripley

perks.name: Machine Learning
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it becomes compromised.

When any compromised Generator is completed by Survivors:
• You gain 8% Haste for 40/50/60s.
• You gain Undetectable for 40/50/60s.
• Other Generators lose compromised.

Up to 3 Generators can be compromised at a time.
perks.flavor: "YOU WILL HOLD NO DOMINION OVER ME!" — HUX-A7-13

perks.name: Mad Grit
perks.description:
While carrying a Survivor:
• Whenever you miss a basic-attack, your cooldown is 100% shorter.
• Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic attack, the carried Survivor gains no wiggle progress for 2/3/4s.
perks.flavor: "There's no getting out of this now. We're too good at it." — The Legion

perks.name: Made for This
perks.description:
While injured, whenever you finish healing another Survivor, you gain Endurance for 6/8/10s.

While you are running and have DeepWound, you gain 3% Haste.
perks.flavor: "I didn't come here to be robot food!" — Gabriel Soma

perks.name: Make your Choice
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor unhooks another or themselves while you are at least 32m away:
• They scream.
• They gain Exposed for 40/50/60s.

Cooldown: 40/50/60s.
perks.flavor: "You'd be surprised what tools can save a life." — Amanda Young

perks.name: Merciless Storm
perks.description: The first time each Generator has 90% progress: Survivors repairing it get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop repairing, that Generator is blocked for 16/18/20s.

perks.name: Mettle of Man
perks.description:
After taking 3 protection hits, while injured and until you go down, the next time you would be downed by the Killer, take no damage instead.

When you become healthy, while you are at least 12/14/16m from the Killer, they see your Aura.

When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
perks.flavor: "Evil has a bullseye on my back the size of Tiger Stadium." — Ash Williams

perks.name: Mindbreaker
perks.description:
While Survivors are repairing a Generator:
• They gain Blindness.
• They gain Exhausted.

When they stop repairing a Generator, this ends after 3/4/5s.
perks.flavor: "The specimen's apparent telepathic ability can evoke feelings of dread and fatigue in nearby individuals." — Hawkins National Laboratory

perks.name: Mirrored Illusion
perks.description: After repairing 20% of Generators, while next to a Chest, Exit Gate Switch, Generator, or Totem, use second ability button to create a static illusion for 40/50/60s.
perks.flavor: "Just... stay there... perfect!" — Baermar

perks.name: Moment of Glory
perks.description:
After you rummage or unlock 1 Chest, while not Broken, when you become injured, gain Broken.

After 80/70/60s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.
perks.flavor: "Never lose hope for a brighter tomorrow." — Trevor

perks.name: Monitor & Abuse
perks.description:
While chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is 5/10/15% bigger.

While not chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is 15/20/25% smaller.
perks.flavor: "It's time for your treatment!" — Herman Carter, The Doctor

perks.name: Nemesis
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor blinds you, Locker-stuns or Pallet-stuns you, they become the Obsession.

Whenever a Survivor becomes the Obsession:
• They gain Oblivious for 40/50/60s.
• You see their Aura for 8s.
perks.flavor: "Only a fool would spit in a demon's face and declare victory." — Renjiro's Doctrine 4:9

perks.name: No Mither
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you become injured, then:
• You gain Broken.
• Your Grunts of Pain are 100% quieter.
• You leave no Pools of Blood.
• You recover 15/20/25% faster.
• You can fully recover.
perks.flavor: "I lost it. Just lamped him one. They went and banned me didn't they. Went t'pub afterwards, had a few pints and moved on to the next chapter. I couldn't be mithered with it all anyway, you know what I mean? Can't be arsed." — David King

perks.name: No One Left Behind
perks.description:
When all Generators are completed:
• You heal other Survivors 80/90/100% faster.
• You unhook other Survivors 80/90/100% faster.
• Whenever you unhook a Survivor, they gain 10% more Haste.
• You see the Auras of other Survivors.

perks.name: No Quarter
perks.description: While self-healing, whenever a Survivor has 75% progress, they get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop healing, they gain Broken for 20/25/30s.
perks.flavor: "Fire another broadside! Don't stop until the sea takes them!" — Portia Maye

perks.name: No Way Out
perks.description:
The first time you Hook each Survivor, you earn 1 Token.

When all Generators are completed, when a Survivor starts opening an Exit Gate:
• It is blocked 12s, plus 6/9/12s for each Token.
• You are alerted.
perks.flavor: "That sound when you bleed... let me hear it again." — Ji-Woon Hak

perks.name: None Are Free
perks.description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, earn 1 Token.

When all Generators are completed, for each Token:
• Upright Pallets are blocked for 12/14/16s.
• Windows are blocked for 12/14/16s.

perks.name: Nowhere to Hide
perks.description: Whenever you damage a Generator, for 3/4/5s, you see the Auras of Survivors within 24m of it.
perks.flavor: "Out with you, cowards! Show yourselves!" — Tarhos Kovács

perks.name: ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR!
perks.description:
While idle, use second ability button to perform, empowering all Survivors within 16m for up to 15s. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. You get special Skill Checks during that time: while healing or repairing, basic Skill Checks are 20% more likely to appear.

If you complete the performance, the effect ends after 90s. Cooldown: 110/100/90s.

perks.name: Object of Obsession
perks.description:
While you are the Obsession, every 30s, the Killer sees your Aura for 4s.

While the Killer sees your Aura:
• You see their Aura.
• You bless and cleanse Totems 8/9/10% faster.
• You heal 8/9/10% faster.
• You repair 8/9/10% faster.

When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
perks.flavor: "He was watching me!" — Laurie Strode

perks.name: Off the Record
perks.description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next 30/35/40s:
• You gain Endurance.
• Your Grunts of Pain are 100% quieter.
• The Killer cannot see your Aura.
perks.flavor: "Trust me, I investigate thoroughly and discreetly." — Zarina Kassir

perks.name: Open-Handed
perks.description: All Survivors see Auras that have a range from 8/12/16m farther.
perks.flavor: "Paying attention is what kept me alive through the years. That, and my good looks of course." — Ace Visconti

perks.name: Oppression
perks.description: Whenever you damage a Generator, up to 4 other Generators start regressing. Survivors repairing them get a special Skill Check. Cooldown: 45/40/35s.
perks.flavor: "Damn them as they would damn us." — Charlotte Deshayes

perks.name: Overcharge
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator:
• Its regression speed will go from 85% to 130% over the next 30s.
• The next Survivor who starts repairing it gets a special Skill Check. If they miss it, they lose 2/3/4% more progress.
perks.flavor: "It is a trap, But a trap one must step in..." — Herman Carter

perks.name: Overcome
perks.description:
Whenever you take damage:
• You retain your speed boost for 2s longer.
• You gain Exhausted for 60/50/40s.
perks.flavor: "After careful analysis, we are getting the hell out of here!" — Jonah Vasquez

perks.name: Overwhelming Presence
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor uses an item within 32m of you, they gain Exhausted for 15s.

Whenever a Survivor within 32m of you gains Exhausted, you see the closest Exhausted Survivor's Aura for 2/3/4s. Cooldown: 25s.
perks.flavor: "Shit!! I dropped the gauze!"

perks.name: Overzealous
perks.description: Whenever you bless or cleanse a Totem, until you take damage, you repair 8/9/10% faster. If that Totem was a Hex Totem, the effect is doubled.
perks.flavor: "The Ravage senses us. We need to work fast." — Haddie Kaur, Ravages of the Abyss Episode 9

perks.name: Parental Guidance
perks.description:
Whenever you stun the Killer, for 5/6/7s:
• You make no Grunts of Pain.
• You leave no Pools of Blood.
• You leave no Scratch Marks.

perks.name: Phantom Fear
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor within your Terror Radius looks at you, they scream, then you see their Aura for 2s. Cooldown: 80/70/60s.

perks.name: Pharmacy
perks.description:
Whenever you unlock a Chest, it will contain a rare Med-Kit.

You unlock and rummage Chests 75/100/125% faster.

You can rummage each Chest 1 time.

The range at which the Killer hears you unlocking Chests is 12m shorter.
perks.flavor: "Adrenaline, it is going to keep us awake. I stole it from one of the Nurse's carts." — Quentin Smith

perks.name: Play With Your Food
perks.description:
Whenever you stop chasing the Obsession, you earn 1 Token, up to 3. Cooldown: 10s.

For each Token, gain 3/4/5% Haste.

Whenever you attack, lose 1 Token.
perks.flavor: "You've fooled them, haven't you Michael? But not me." — Dr Sam Loomis

perks.name: Plot Twist
perks.description:
While injured, crouched and idle, use second ability button to be downed silently.

While downed this way, once per trial:
• You make no Grunts of Pain.
• You leave no Pools of Blood.
• You recover 25% faster.
• You can fully recover.

Whenever you recover this way:
• You gain 50% Haste for 2/3/4s.
• You are healed instantly.

When all Generators are completed, you can use this ability once again.
perks.flavor: "I think you'll find this shooting location... captivating." — Pauline Stamper

perks.name: Plunderer's Instinct
perks.description:
You see the Aura of Chests and items.

You unlock Chests 150/175/200% faster.

Whenever you unlock a Chest you are 50% more likely to find an Item of higher rarity.
perks.flavor: "The pioneers used to loot these babies for hours." — Aizeyu, The Lost Tapes

perks.name: Poised
perks.description:
The first time you start repairing each Generator, you see the Killer's Aura for 8s.

Whenever a Generator is completed, you leave no Scratch Marks for 20/25/30s.
perks.flavor: "Ok, stay calm. Don't overthink it and just keep moving forward: you got this." — Jane Romero

perks.name: Pop Goes the Weasel
perks.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, for the next 35/40/45s, when you damage a Generator, it explodes and loses 15% more progress.

perks.name: Potential Energy
perks.description:
While repairing, use second ability button to earn Tokens instead of progress, up to 10/15/20 Tokens.

While you have at least 1 Token, second ability button to spend all Tokens and gain 1% progress for each Token spent.

Whenever you take damage, lose all Tokens.
perks.flavor: "When you look a layer deeper, you realise... everything is connected." — Vittorio Toscano

perks.name: Power Struggle
perks.description:
While carried by the Killer, while you have at least 25/20/15% wiggle and next to an Upright Pallet, you can drop it to stun the Killer.

While downed, you see the Auras of Upright Pallets.
perks.flavor: "I relied on others to protect me once and I lost everything. Never again." — Élodie Rakoto

perks.name: Predator
perks.description: When you stop chasing a Survivor, you see their Aura for 4s. Cooldown: 60/50/40s.
perks.flavor: "Never stop moving and hope you're always two steps ahead of the beast." — Unknown, Notebook

perks.name: Premonition
perks.description:
While not chased by the Killer, whenever you look in the Killer’s direction within 32m:
• You are notified.
• You see the Killer's Aura for 3s.

Cooldown: 55/50/45s.
perks.flavor: "I have a bad feeling about this!"

perks.name: Prove Thyself
perks.description: For each other Survivor within 4m of you, all Survivors repair 6/8/10% faster.
perks.flavor: "Show me what you can do!" — Dwight Fairfield

perks.name: Quick & Quiet
perks.description: You hide in Lockers and vault silently. The Killer is not alerted. Cooldown: 25/20/15s.

perks.name: Quick Gambit
perks.description:
While chased by the Killer:
• You see the Auras of other Survivors.
• Other Survivors repair 3/4/5% faster.

Whenever you take damage, cooldown: 40s.
perks.flavor: "We need not resort to violence. And I shall prove it." — Vittorio Toscano

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description:
Whenever you basic-break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, you earn 1 Token, up to 13.

Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, for the next 13s you gain 1% Haste for each Token. Cooldown: 30/25/20.

perks.name: Rancor
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed:
• You are alerted to the position of all Survivors for 3s.
• The Obsession sees your Aura for 5/4/3s.

When all Generators are completed:
• The Obsession gains Exposed.
• You can Kill the Obsession.

perks.name: Rapid Brutality
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, you gain 5% Haste for 8/9/10s.

While chasing a Survivor, you cannot gain Bloodlust.
perks.flavor: "Catch it, put it in the airlock, get rid of it." — Dallas

perks.name: Rapid Response
perks.description:
Whenever you fast-exit a Locker, you gain Exhausted for 30/25/20s.

Whenever you gain Exhausted, you see the Killer's Aura for 2s.

perks.name: Ravenous
perks.description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn 1 Token. For each Token:
• Gain 4% Haste while carrying a Survivor.
• Hook Survivors 4% faster.

When you have 4 Tokens, all Survivors:
• Scream.
• Gain Exposed for 80/85/90s.

perks.name: Reactive Healing
perks.description: While injured, whenever another Survivor within 32m of you takes damage, you gain 40/45/50% missing healing progress.

perks.name: Reassurance
perks.description: Once per Hook State, while within 6m of a hooked Survivor, use second ability button to stop the sacrifice progress for 20/25/30s.

perks.name: Red Herring
perks.description:
After you repair a Generator for at least 1s, you see its Aura.

When you hide in a Locker, the Killer is alerted to the Generator. Cooldown: 25/20/15s.
perks.flavor: "The news edit out what is burdensome and complex. which is the truth." — Zarina Kassir

perks.name: Remember Me
perks.description:
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, you earn 1 Token, up to 3/4/5.

For each Token, Survivors who are not the Obsession open Exit Gates 30% slower.
perks.flavor: "You don't remember? You must. You're my number one, and you'll never wake up again." — Freddy Krueger

perks.name: Repressed Alliance
perks.description: After repairing Generators for 40/35/30s, while repairing a Generator alone, use ability button to block that generator for 15s.

perks.name: Residual Manifest
perks.description:
Whenever you blind the Killer, they gain Blindness for 20/25/30s.

You can rummage Chests 1 time. The first time you rummage a Chest, it will contain an uncommon Flashlight.
perks.flavor: "I'll never see what Haddie sees. But so long as I'm with her, I know I'm safe." — Jordan Rois, Ravages of the Abyss Episode 5

perks.name: Resilience
perks.description:
While injured:
• You bless and cleanse Totems 7/8/9% faster.
• You heal 7/8/9% faster.
• You open Exit Gates 7/8/9% faster.
• You repair 7/8/9% faster.
• You sabotage Hooks 7/8/9% faster.
• You unhook Survivors 7/8/9% faster.
• You unlock chests 7/8/9% faster.
• You vault 7/8/9% faster.
perks.flavor: "Focus, even in these desperate times."

perks.name: Resurgence
perks.description: Whenever you are unhooked, you gain 50/60/70% healing progress.
perks.flavor: "It's my turn, bitch!" — Jill Valentine

perks.name: Road Life
perks.description:
While injured and repairing a Generator:
• Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn 1 Token.
• Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose 1 token.

When you have 6/5/4 Tokens, you can heal yourself. Spend all Tokens to heal yourself 10% faster. When you stop healing, this ends after 4s.

perks.name: Rookie Spirit
perks.description: After you hit 5/4/3 basic repair Skill Checks, while a Generator is regressing, you see its Aura.
perks.flavor: "I'll stop this, lieutenant. I promise." — Leon Scott Kennedy

perks.name: Saboteur
perks.description:
Within 56m of where another Survivor was picked-up by the Killer and is being carried, you see the Auras of Hooks and Scourge Hooks.

You can sabotage Hooks. Cooldown: 70/65/60s.

perks.name: Salvation's Cry
perks.description:
Whenever the Killer starts chasing you:
• You see the Auras of other Survivors for 1/2/3s.
• Survivors not being chased see your Aura for 5s.
• Survivors not being chased see the Killer's Aura for 5s.

perks.name: Save the best for last
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor who is not the Obsession with a basic-attack, you earn 1 Token, up to 6/7/8.

For each Token, your successful basic-attack cooldown is 5% shorter.

Whenever the Obsession takes damage, lose 2 Tokens.

While the Obsession is dead, you cannot earn Tokens.
perks.flavor: "Death has come to your little town, Sheriff." — Dr Sam Loomis

perks.name: Scavenger
perks.description:
While repairing and while your Toolbox is empty, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn 1 Token.

When you have 5 Tokens, spend them all:
• Your Toolbox is recharged instantly.
• You repair 50% slower for 40/35/30s.

You can rummage Chests 1 time. The first time you rummage a Chest, it will contain an uncommon Toolbox.
perks.flavor: "It's amazing what people will throw away around here." — Gabriel Soma

perks.name: Scene Partner
perks.description:
While you are within the Killer's Terror Radius, whenever you look at them:
• Scream, then see the Killer's Aura for 4/5/6s.
• There is a 50% chance you will scream again. If you do, you see the Killer's Aura for 2s more.

Cooldown: 40s.
perks.flavor: "This is not in the script!" — Nicolas Cage

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage
perks.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, you see the Auras of other Survivors for 5/6/7s.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Gift of Pain
perks.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook:
• They gain Hemorrhage for 90s.
• They gain Mangled for 90s.
• When they are healed, until they take damage, they heal and repair 10/13/16% slower.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick
perks.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

While carrying a Survivor, you see the Auras of Survivors within 12/14/16m of Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor starts sabotaging a Hook, you are alerted.
perks.flavor: "No excuses, no equivocations... No crying." — Amanda Young

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
perks.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked, the Hook becomes a Scourge Hook.

Whenever you hook a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, for 6/8/10s, you see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress.
perks.flavor: "Drop anchor! I will chart us a new course." — Portia Maye

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
perks.description:
When the Trial starts:
• 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
• The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

While you are at least 24m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, any Generator that isn't being repaired regresses at 150/175/200% speed.
perks.flavor: "Then you will know that there is no escape. When hanging in the depths, you face the dark one."

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
perks.description:
When the trial starts:
• 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
• You earn 4 Tokens.

The first time each Survivor is hooked on a Scourge Hook, spend 1 Token, then the Generator with the most progress:
• Explodes, loses 10/15/20% progress and starts regressing.
• Survivors repairing it scream.
perks.flavor: "The pain spills beyond flesh/darkness staining the horizon." — Girl in the Shadow by Carmina Mora

perks.name: Second Wind
perks.description:
After you heal 1 Survivor, while not Broken, when you are unhooked, you gain Broken.

After 28/24/20s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.
perks.flavor: "Yeah, that's a no." — Steve Harrington

perks.name: Secret Project
perks.description:
Whenever a Totem is blessed or cleansed, a random unblocked Generator is blocked for 20/25/30s.

Whenever 1 or more Generators are blocked, you gain Undetectable for 30s.

perks.name: Self-Care
perks.description: You can heal yourself, but 75/70/65% slower.

perks.name: Self-Preservation
perks.description: Whenever another Survivor is hooked, you gain Elusive for 13/14/15s.
perks.flavor: "Something I learnt in the industry: when the axe is swinging, keep your head down." — Yun-Jin Lee

perks.name: Septic Touch
perks.description:
While a Survivor within your Terror Radius is healing:
• They gain Blindness.
• They gain Exhausted.

When they stop healing, this ends after 20/25/30s.
perks.flavor: "Do not admit to fear, or pain, or doubt. These are the seeds from which darkness grows." — Otto Stamper

perks.name: Shadowborn
perks.description: Whenever you are blinded, gain 6/8/10% Haste for 10s.
perks.flavor: "Shining in the darkest dark, his eyes pierce the night and sting your soul."

perks.name: Shattered Hope
perks.description:
Whenever you snuff a Boon Totem, it is destroyed.

Whenever a Totem is blessed, cleansed or destroyed:
• Dull Totems are blocked for 16/18/20s.
• Hex Totems are blocked for 16/18/20s.
• See Boon Totems' Auras for 16/18/20s.
perks.flavor: "Nothing is permanent here. Nothing except our endless perdition." — Unknown, Notebook

perks.name: Shoulder the Burden
perks.description:
Once per trial, if you have less than 2 Hook States while you are next to a hooked Survivor, use second ability button to unhook them:
• They lose 1 Hook State.
• You gain 1 Hook State.
• You scream.
• You become Injured.
• You gain Broken for 160/140/120s.
perks.flavor: "It's not your time yet. Now go on!" — Taurie Cain

perks.name: Silent Shadow
perks.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, you gain Undetectable for 11/12/13s.

When all Generators are completed, you gain Undetectable.

perks.name: Slippery Meat
perks.description:
Other Survivors unhook you 90/95/100% faster.

Whenever you are unhooked, you gain 5% more Haste.

perks.name: Sloppy Butcher
perks.description:
You know where to hit to make them bleed.
• Wounds inflicted by Basic Attacks cause Survivors to suffer from the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects for 70/80/90 seconds.
• Increases the Bleeding frequency of injured Survivors by 50/75/100% for the same duration.
• Increases the Regression rate at which partial Healing Progression is lost because of Haemorrhage by +25%.
perks.flavor: "It is in its sadistic nature. There is no swift kill as it delights in the obscene spectacle of our agonising suffering."

perks.name: Small Game
perks.description: Within 10/11/12m of a Totem, you see its Aura.
perks.flavor: "Nope." — Andy, The Lost Tapes

perks.name: Smash Hit
perks.description:
Whenever you Pallet-stun the Killer:
• You gain 50% Haste for 4s.
• You gain Exhausted for 30/25/20s.
perks.flavor: "I have dealt with psychopaths in suits. You're just uglier and worse dressed." — Yun-Jin Lee

perks.name: Sole Survivor
perks.description:
Whenever you are hooked or complete a Generator, you earn 1 Token, up to 6.

For each Token, other Survivors open Exit Gates 10% faster.

When you are the last Survivor, if you have at least 3 Tokens:
• You can unlock the Hatch.
• For each Token, the Killer cannot see your Aura for 6/8/10s.
perks.flavor: "It was the boogeyman." — Laurie Strode

perks.name: Solidarity
perks.description: While injured and healing another Survivor, you also gain healing progress at 65/70/75% speed.
perks.flavor: "Showing up when things get rough, listening to people's problems, and supporting those in need; that's how you become stronger, that's how you grow." — Jane Romero

perks.name: Soul Guard
perks.description:
While hexed, you can fully recover.

Whenever you fully recover, you gain Endurance for 4/6/8s. Cooldown: 30s.

perks.name: Specialist
perks.description:
Whenever you rummage or unlock a Chest, you earn 1 Token, up to 6.

While repairing a Generator, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains 2/3/4% permanent progress.
perks.flavor: "Well, then. Doesn't this feel familiar?" — Lara Croft

perks.name: Spies from the Shadows
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor scares a Crow within 36/38/40m of you, you are alerted. Cooldown: 3s.
perks.flavor: "In the shadows they torment, scarring our minds with each scream."

perks.name: Spine Chill
perks.description:
Whenever the Killer looks at you within 40m:
• You are notified.
• You cannot scream for 12s.
• You vault 10% faster for 12s.

Cooldown: 40/35/30s
perks.flavor: "There is a voice that doesn't use words. Listen.." — Sassy, The Lost Tapes

perks.name: Spirit Fury
perks.description: After you break 4/3/2 Pallets, when you are Pallet-stunned, the Pallet is destroyed.
perks.flavor: "Fury is her blood."

perks.name: Sprint Burst
perks.description:
Whenever you start running:
• You gain 50% Haste for 2s.
• You gain Exhausted for 60/50/40s.
perks.flavor: "See you if you can catch up..." — Meg Thomas

perks.name: Stake Out
perks.description:
After hiding for 15s within 24m of the Killer, while in their Terror Radius, you earn 1 Token, up to 2/3/4.

While you have at least 1 Token, basic Skill Checks are replaced by special Skill Checks. Special Skill Checks grant +4% more progress.

Whenever you hit or miss a special Skill Check, spend 1 Token.
perks.flavor: "I had you, I had you on your knees. You're runnin' scared because we had you. We're gonna close this case!" — Detective David Tapp

perks.name: Starstruck
perks.description:
While carrying a Survivor, Survivors within your Terror Radius gain Exposed. This ends 26/28/30s after:
• They leave your Terror Radius.
• You drop or Hook the carried Survivor.

Cooldown: 60s.
perks.flavor: "Enjoy this moment, few get so close." — Ji-Woon Hak

perks.name: Still Sight
perks.description:
After being idle for 4/3/2s, within 24m, until you start moving:
• You see the Killer's Aura.
• You see the Auras of Chests.
• You see the Auras of Generators.
perks.flavor: "Breathe in. Breathe out. Now open your eyes." — Baermar

perks.name: Streetwise
perks.description:
The first time you deplete an item's Charges, you see the Killer's Aura for 8s.

Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it has 60/70/80% more Charges.
perks.flavor: "You are doing it wrong! Let me show you how it is done." — Nea Karlsson

perks.name: Strength in Shadows
perks.description:
While in the Basement:
• You can heal yourself, but 30% slower.
• Whenever you finish healing, you see the Killer's Aura for 6/8/10s.
perks.flavor: "I'm getting out of here, if it's the last thing I do." — Sable

perks.name: Stridor
perks.description: Survivors' breathing noises are 15/20/25% louder and their Grunts of Pain are 30/40/50% louder.
perks.flavor: "If you do not stop and catch your breath... she will."

perks.name: Superior Anatomy
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor medium or fast-vaults within 12m of you, the next time you basic-vault a Window, you basic-vault Windows 30/35/40% faster for 10s. Cooldown: 20s.

perks.name: Surge
perks.description:
Whenever you down a Survivor with a basic-attack, Generators within 32m:
• Explode, lose 6/7/8% progress and start regressing.
• Survivor repairing them scream.
perks.flavor: "The creature appears to have some unknown influence over electricity and nearby electronics." — Hawkins National Laboratory

perks.name: Surveillance
perks.description:
You see the Auras of regressing Generators.

Whenever a Generator stops regressing, you see its Aura for 8/12/16s.

Generator repair noises can be heard from 8m farther away.
perks.flavor: "Are you gonna behave?" — Amanda Young

perks.name: THWACK!
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you earn 3 Tokens, up to 3.

Whenever you hook a Survivor, you earn 1 Token.

Whenever you break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, spend 1 Token. Then, all Survivors within 36m scream and you see their Auras for 4/5/6s.
perks.flavor: "All those who stood in her path feared her mighty THWACK!" — Sonhadores Sombrios, Issue #3
