perks.name: Teamwork: Collective Stealth
perks.description: Whenever another Survivor finishes healing you, while within 8/12/16m of each other, you both leave no Scratch Marks. When either of you leaves the range, this ends after 4s.
perks.flavor: "I'm good, I'm good... but keep it down." — Renato Lyra

perks.name: Teamwork: Full Circuit
perks.description:
For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, good basic Skill Check zones are 15/20/25% bigger.

While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5% faster.

perks.name: Teamwork: Power of Two
perks.description: Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while you stay within 8/12/16m of each other, you both gain 5% Haste. When either of you leaves the range, this ends after 4s.
perks.flavor: "You good? Then keep up!" — Thalita Lyra

perks.name: Teamwork: Soft-Spoken
perks.description:
For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, the range of Generator repair noises is 15/20/25% smaller.

While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5% faster.

perks.name: Teamwork: Throw Down
perks.description:
Whenever you blind or Pallet-stun the Killer, for 6/8/10s, other injured Survivors within 24m:
• Gain Endurance.
• See the Killer's Aura.

perks.name: Teamwork: Toughen Up
perks.description:
While injured, whenever another Survivor within 24m of you blinds or Pallet-stuns the Killer, for 20/25/30s:
• You make no Grunts of Pain.
• You leave no Pools of Blood.
• You leave no Scratch Marks.

perks.name: Technician
perks.description:
While repairing a Generator:
• The range of Generator repair noises is 16m shorter.
• Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, the Generator does not explode, but loses 4/3/2% more progress.
perks.flavor: "I am gonna stealth this one." — Feng Min

perks.name: Tenacity
perks.description:
While downed:
• You gain 30/40/50% Haste.
• You can crawl and recover at the same time.
• Your Grunts of Pain are 75% quieter.
• The Killer cannot see your Aura.
perks.flavor: "What the hell is this? I'm taking this bastard down!" — Detective David Tapp

perks.name: Terminus
perks.description:
When all Generators are completed: all injured, downed, and hooked Survivors gain Broken.

When an Exit Gate is opened, this ends after 35/40/45s.

perks.name: Territorial Imperative
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor enters the Basement while you are 24m away from it, you see their Aura for 4/5/6s. Cooldown: 45s.
perks.flavor: "We're not safe anywhere..."

perks.name: Thanatophobia
perks.description:
For each injured, downed, or hooked Survivor, all Survivors:
• Cleanse Totems 1/1.5/2% slower.
• Repair 1/1.5/2% slower.
• Sabotage Hooks 1/1.5/2% slower.

While 4 Survivors are either injured, downed or hooked, all above actions are additionally 12% slower.
perks.flavor: "She plays with us and revels in our pain."

perks.name: This Is Not Happening
perks.description: Good basic Skill Check zones are 150/175/200% bigger.

perks.name: Thrilling Tremors
perks.description: Whenever you pick-up a Survivor, all Generators not being repaired are blocked for 16s. Cooldown: 40/35/30s.
perks.flavor: "The night assists me and it's endless here." — The Ghost Face

perks.name: Tinkerer
perks.description:
The first time each Generator has 70% progress:
• You gain Undetectable for 12/14/16s.
• You are alerted.
perks.flavor: "The Hillbilly makes impressive tools out of scraps. Tools aimed at maiming us in creative ways." — Notebook

perks.name: Trail of Torment
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, until it stops regressing:
• You gain undetectable.
• Survivors see that Generator's Aura.

Cooldown: 60/45/30s.

perks.name: Troubleshooter
perks.description:
While chased by the Killer:
• You see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress.
• Whenever you drop a Pallet, you see the Killer's Aura for 4/5/6s.

When the Killer stops chasing you, this ends after 6/8/10s.
perks.flavor: "Nothing gets done around here if I don't do it." — Gabriel Soma

perks.name: Turn Back The Clock
perks.description: After hooking a Survivor, for the next 40/50/60s, use ability button to make target Generator you can see within 20m explode, lose 10% progress and start regressing.

perks.name: Ultimate Weapon
perks.description:
Whenever you search a Locker, Survivors within 40m:
• Gain Blindness for 30s.
• Scream.

Cooldown: 55/50/45s.
perks.flavor: "I can't lie to you about your chances, but... you have my sympathies." — Ash

perks.name: Unbound
perks.description: Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, for the next 26/28/30s, whenever you basic-vault a window, gain 5% Haste for 25s.
perks.flavor: "I heard it. Running. It was getting closer!" — Anonymous Testimony, 09/09/1979

perks.name: Unbreakable
perks.description:
Once per trial, while downed by the Killer, you can fully recover.

While downed, you recover 25/30/35% faster.
perks.flavor: "Goddammit, I am seriously FUBAR!" — Bill Overbeck

perks.name: Undone
perks.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, earn 1 Token, up to 3.

Whenever you damage a Generator, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent:
• The Generator loses 8/9/10% more progress.
• The Generator is blocked for 8/9/10s.
perks.flavor: "Erratic behavior in machinery could be related to [REDACTED], further testing required." — OSS Report, 12/02/1943

perks.name: Unforeseen
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator:
• Your Terror Radius is set to that Generator for 22/26/30s and its radius is 32m.
• You gain Undetectable for that time.

Cooldown: 30s.
perks.flavor: "Mom, if you find this, I'm sorry..." — Final Journal Entry, 07/12/1991

perks.name: Unnerving Presence
perks.description:
Survivors within your Terror Radius get 10% more basic Skill Checks.

The good zone of basic Skill Checks is 40/50/60% smaller.
perks.flavor: "Its presence befalls us."

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description:
Your missed basic-attack cooldown is 30/35/40% shorter.

Your successful basic-attack cooldown is 10% shorter.

perks.name: Up the Ante
perks.description:
For each other Survivor alive, all Survivors are 1/2/3% luckier.

All Survivors can attempt to unhook themselves.
perks.flavor: "What can I say? I'm just a very lucky guy... I'm sure some of it will rub off on you." — Ace Visconti

perks.name: Urban Evasion
perks.description: While crouched, you gain 90/95/100% Haste.
perks.flavor: "The paint is still fresh but I am long gone." — Nea Karlsson

perks.name: Vigil
perks.description:
All Survivors within 16m of you lose Exhausted 20/25/30% faster.

This effect ends 15s after they leave your range.
perks.flavor: "I am gonna be here when you wake up. You are gonna make it." — Quentin Smith

perks.name: Visionary
perks.description:
Within 32m of you, you see the Auras of Generators.

Whenever a Generator is completed, cooldown: 20/18/16s.

perks.name: Wake Up!
perks.description:
When all Generators are completed:
• You see the Auras of Exit Gate Switches.
• While opening an Exit Gate, other Survivors see your Aura.
• You open Exit Gates 8/9/10% faster, and an additional 20% faster for each other Survivor alive.
perks.flavor: "Ok, look. If we survive the next 24 hours, then I'll take you out on a real date." — Quentin Smith

perks.name: Wandering Eye
perks.description: Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, for the next 5s, you see the Auras of all other injured Survivors within 20m. Cooldown: 40/35/30s.

perks.name: We See You
perks.description:
Whenever the Killer sees your Aura, you earn 1 Token. Cooldown: 10s.

When you have 4 Tokens, spend them all. Then, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for 10/12.5/15s.

perks.name: We'll make it
perks.description: Whenever you unhook a Survivor, for 70/80/90s, you heal other Survivors 100% faster.
perks.flavor: "I am confident we can all escape in one piece if we help each other."

perks.name: We're Gonna Live Forever
perks.description:
You heal downed Survivors 100% faster.

Whenever you finish healing a downed Survivor, they gain Endurance for 6/8/10s. Cooldown: 30s.
perks.flavor: "Come on then, let's ave' it! I don't give a shit pal." — David King

perks.name: Weave Attunement
perks.description:
The first time each item is depleted, it is dropped.

While a Survivor is within 12m of a dropped item:
• You see their Aura.
• They see the item's Aura.

Whenever a Survivor picks-up an item, they gain Oblivious for 20/25/30s.
perks.flavor: "No number of novelties will protect you from me!" — Vecna

perks.name: Whispers
perks.description:
While within 28/26/24m of a Survivor, you randomly hear whispers.

While more than 28/26/24m away from a Survivor, gain 5% Haste.
perks.flavor: "It is unclear as to the motivations of The Fog, but it is undeniable that it often takes the beast's side." — Unknown, Notebook

perks.name: Wicked
perks.description:
While in the Basement, you can unhook yourself.

Whenever you are unhooked, you see the Killer's Aura for 16/18/20s.
perks.flavor: "I haven't let anyone get in my way before. You think I'm gonna start now?" — Sable

perks.name: Wide Open Throttle
perks.description:
Whenever you fast-vault a Pallet:
• You gain 10/12.5/15% Haste for 3s.
• The Pallet is reset, blocked for 60s, and all Survivors see its Aura for that time.

Cooldown: 60s.

perks.name: Windows of Opportunity
perks.description:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability.
The Auras of Breakable Walls, Pallets, and Windows are revealed to you within 24/28/32 metres.
"Rise and shine, work hard, carve out your name,
Take aim, pull the trigger, hit the bulls eye for fame,
Know the value of faith, an' family, and don't you complain,
Open wide, your windows of opportunity" — Kate Denson's "Windows of Opportunity"

perks.name: Wiretap
perks.description:
After repairing 40% of Generators, while next to a Generator, use second ability button to trap it for 100/110/120s or until the Killer damages that Generator. All Survivors see that Generator's Aura for that time.

While the Killer is within 14m of that Generator, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura.

perks.name: Zanshin Tactics
perks.description:
Within 32m, you see the Auras of Pallets and windows.

Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, you see their Aura for 3/4/5s.
perks.flavor: "Within your enemy's strength is weakness." — Renjiro's Doctrine 12:5
